newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-STRASBOURG'S NOUMA BANNED FOR ATTACKING OPPPONENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STRASBOURG'S NOUMA BANNED FOR ATTACKING OPPPONENT.

text.p: Strasbourg's striker Pascal Nouma was given a one-month ban by the discipline committee of the French National Soccer League on Thursday for assaulting Metz defender Pascal Pierre at the end of a league match last week.
Nouma, who admitted butting Pierre while walking back to the dressing-rooms, claimed his opponent had shouted racist insults at him during the match. He will miss six league matches.
Pierre, who suffered a broken nose, denied the allegations, saying he had been the victim of "a cold blooded attack".
